To make these effects work, we estimate the location of parts of your face (like your eyes) and points on your face, eyes, or hands. For some effects, we apply these points to a generic model of a face and adjust it to mimic your expressions and movements so you can do things like wear a cat mask that smiles when you do. This technology is not facial recognition and this information is not used to identify you.
